question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_best_per_race AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, MAX(points) as best_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY constructor_id, year
),
driver_best_per_constructor_year AS (
    SELECT d.constructor_id, r.year, MAX(ds.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE d.constructor_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.constructor_id, r.year
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cbp.constructor_id, cbp.year, cbp.best_constructor_points, bdp.best_driver_points,
           cbp.best_constructor_points + bdp.best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_best_per_race cbp
    JOIN driver_best_per_constructor_year bdp 
        ON cbp.constructor_id = bdp.constructor_id AND cbp.year = bdp.year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, combined_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY combined_points DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
)
SELECT r.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, r.year, r.combined_points
FROM ranked r
JOIN constructors c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY r.combined_points DESC, r.year
